title: Phased RBAC v2 backfill validation, dual-write gating, and customer deprecation playbook
creator: Aisha Khan
description:
Objective: Execute a low-risk, observable migration from RBAC v1 to RBAC v2 that preserves audit trails and SSO mappings, provides deterministic admin behavior, and gives customers a clear deprecation path for legacy roles.

Scope: backfill v2 role bindings for existing accounts, run dual-write for a configurable trial window, verify read-path parity under RBAC v2, ensure audit logging continuity across cutover, validate SAML/SSO attribute mappings (email/SSO ID -> role mapping), and publish a staged customer deprecation and comms plan.

Success criteria: 
- 99.9% parity for authorization decisions between v1 and v2 in dual-write window for sampled requests (see parity runbook).
- No gaps in audit log events for principal/role changes during migration (end-to-end audit verification).
- Automated backfill completes for 95% of customers without manual intervention; remaining fallbacks flagged with remediation tasks.
- Customer-facing deprecation announcement published and sent with clear opt-out/rollback instructions.

Risks and trade-offs: 
- Immediate strict cutover risks customer breakage for bespoke SSO mappings; mitigation: multi-week beta with targeted customers and toggle.
- Backfill scale: running backfills online could add load to account-service; mitigation: rate-limited worker pool + DB throttling.
- Audit integrity: transforming role identifiers requires canonicalization to prevent duplicate/masked events; mitigation: write canonical_id alongside legacy_id in audit events.

Out-of-scope: UI redesign for admin console (separate DES ticket).

acceptance_criteria: Backfill job can process entire customer set with resume and audit log events for every transformed binding.
Dual-write mode records both v1_decision and v2_decision in audit events for sampled requests and exposes mismatch metric.
SAML/SSO mapping normalization implemented (case-folding, trimmed whitespace) and covered by unit tests.
Runbook for cutover and rollback reviewed and signed off by security and ops (doc link in links).
Customer deprecation email template and in-console notice drafted and scheduled for PM review.
audit_steps: Enable dual-write on a small canary cohort and capture v1_decision and v2_decision for all auth requests for 72 hours.
Run parity validator over captured events and group mismatches by tenant, endpoint, and SSO attribute differences.
Verify audit event continuity by replaying transformed binding changes into audit-svc and comparing sequence numbers to pre-migration baseline.
Sample admin actions in console and confirm action events contain legacy_role_id and v2_role_id fields for traceability.
Validate that KMS-encrypted fields in audit logs remain decryptable after schema changes (integration test with KMS staging key).
rollout_plan: Phase 0 (internal alpha): Backfill on test tenants, enable dual-write for internal accounts only, verify parity and audit integrity (2 weeks).
Phase 1 (customer beta): Invite 10 low-risk customers, enable dual-write via feature flag per-tenant, provide mapping preview API and support channel (3 weeks).
Phase 2 (wider beta): Expand to 25% customers with automated backfill and alias reconciliation. Monitor mismatch_rate < 0.2% for 7 consecutive days before proceeding.
Phase 3 (cutover window): Schedule customer opt-in cutover window. For customers that opt-in, flip read path to v2 after final backfill; for others maintain dual-write for 90 days.
Phase 4 (deprecation): After 90 days and zero-severity mismatches for >30 days, publish deprecation notice and remove v1 toggles after additional 30-day notice period.
rollback_plan: If mismatch_rate > 1% or critical authorization failures observed, immediately disable v2 read path via feature flag and revert to v1 read path.
Rollback backfill writes by rehydratation from legacy binding snapshots stored prior to backfill (worker supports revert mode).
If audit gaps detected, pause migration and run integrity job to reconcile events using audit-svc replay. Notify legal/compliance if any potential data gaps are found.
Post-rollback: run an RCA and capture action items; do not reattempt cutover until RCA leads are closed.
test_plan: Unit tests for SSO normalization and alias resolution (coverage >= 90%).
Integration test: dual-write end-to-end with audit ingestion using a staging KMS key.
Load test: backfill worker throughput against a synthetic tenant set (simulate 10M bindings) and verify DB latency stays under thresholds.
Chaos test: randomly kill one backfill worker and ensure resume semantics pick up without duplicate bindings.
Manual QA: checklist for ops to validate admin controls and role assignment UI after v2 read path flip.
